title: Bingo-CRB
description: A bingo modpack based on Yet Another Bingo.
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ebfa9dcfca3786702bd3209f8791b5302354563d.jpeg)
## About This Modpack
- This modpack is built around [Yet Another Bingo](https://modrinth.com/mod/yet-another-minecraft-bingo).
- It is largely vanilla-focused, adding a small number of world-generation structures and quality-of-life mods for exploration and team play, while introducing almost no additional modded items to the Bingo board.

## About Bingo Server
- This is a client-side modpack. Server-side mods need to be configured separately.
- For server setup, it is recommended to refer to the server configuration guidelines provided in the Yet Another Bingo project's wiki.

## About Included Mods

### Quality of Life
- JEI and related add-ons  
- Team Chest  
- Jade  

### Exploration
- Xaero's Minimap and World Map  
- Nature's Compass  
- Explorer's Compass  

### Structures
- Structory  
- Towns and Towers  

> These structure mods are included with fairness in mind.  
> They mainly affect world generation and exploration, without introducing Bingo-specific modded items.

### Optimization
- Sodium  
- Other performance-related mods  

## Features
Explorer's Compass and Nature's Compass help players locate specific biomes and structures. These items must be crafted in-game before they can be used.

![Nature's Compass](https://i.imgur.com/175k4oE.png)
![Explorer's Compass](https://i.imgur.com/xSE8VSc.png)

> They are included as a gameplay improvement: compared to wandering aimlessly in search of objectives, compasses with a certain progression cost help reduce randomness and enhance overall playability.

For the same reason, when configuring a server, it is also recommended to consider adding datapacks from  [Vanilla Tweaks](https://vanillatweaks.net/) to further improve the gameplay experience.

## Compass Tier Recommendation
It is recommended to set Explorer's Compass as **Tier A** and Nature's Compass as **Tier B** for Bingo challenges.

You can configure this in-game using the following commands (OP permission required):



```
/bingodata tierlist add challenge a explorerscompass:explorerscompass
/bingodata tierlist add challenge b naturescompass:naturescompass
```
